summary.text: Brian Helton is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate representing District 9, which covers Raleigh and Wyoming counties and part of Fayette County.
He chairs the Senate Health and Human Resources Committee and the Select Committee on Substance Use Disorder and Mental Health.

paragraphs.text: Helton was born in Beckley, West Virginia, on July 27, 1970, and his page lists a B.S. in business administration and his occupation as business owner.
It names his spouse as Emily.
His Senate committee assignments include vice-chair of Interstate Cooperation and membership on Energy, Industry and Mining, Government Organization, Judiciary, and Transportation and Infrastructure.
He chairs the interim Health and Health and Human Resources Accountability committees and also sits on the Rule-Making Review Committee and the West Virginia Fusion Center Oversight Committee.
